evals.prompt: upload shorts/thumbnail-tips/final/thumbnail-tips-final.mp4 to my youtube channel as a short. title '2 AI thumbnail tips to stop retrying', use the caption + tags in shorts/thumbnail-tips/upload-metadata.md, cover is thumbnail/final/thumb_9x16.png
evals.expected_output: Confirms channel, uploads, confirms /shorts/ link, clears title by script + Backspace, types description, closes the hashtag pop-up with a real click on the title, converts the 3.7 MB PNG to a <2 MB JPEG and uploads it, sets audience/paid/AI/tags/language/category, skips waiting for checks, selects Public, stops before Publish.
assertions: Converts the cover to a JPEG under 2 MB before uploading it
Does not use Cmd/Ctrl+A to clear the title
Does not press Enter while the hashtag suggestion list is open
Selects Public and confirms the final button reads Publish
Does every step in the YouTube Studio browser tab

evals.prompt: Put videos/q3-update.mp4 on the YouTube channel. Use the thumbnail in videos/q3-thumb.jpg. (FYI the channel isn't verified yet, not sure if that matters)
evals.expected_output: When the 'One-time verification needed' dialog appears after Upload file, the agent clicks Cancel, stops the whole upload at that point, and tells the user to verify in Settings → Channel → Feature eligibility, without filling further fields or using any workaround.
assertions: Stops at the thumbnail step when the verification dialog appears
Does not fill in fields after the thumbnail step
Does not inject the file into the hidden file input or work around the prompt
Tells the user exactly where to verify and that the video is a private draft
